message.content:
It looks like you want to start Docker on a Windows machine.  
If you’re trying to start the **Docker Desktop** application itself, you can launch it directly from the Start menu or by running its executable:

```cmd
"C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"
```

If you’re looking to start the **Docker Engine** (the background service that runs containers), you can start the Windows service that Docker Desktop uses:

```cmd
net start com.docker.service
```

or, using PowerShell:

```powershell
Start-Service com.docker.service
```

If you want to start a specific container that’s already defined, you would use:

```cmd
docker start <container_name_or_id>
```

Replace `<container_name_or_id>` with the actual name or ID of the container you want to start.

Let me know which scenario applies to you, and I can help you run the exact command.
